crossRefs.note: You shall overlay it with pure gold, its top, its sides around it, and its horns; and you shall make a gold molding…

parallels.note: He overlaid the cherubim with gold.

translations.web: He overlaid it with pure gold inside and outside, and made a molding of gold for it around it.
translations.bsb: He overlaid it with pure gold, both inside and out, and made a gold molding around it.
translations.kjv: And he overlaid it with pure gold within and without, and made a crown of gold to it round about.
translations.asv: and he overlaid it with pure gold within and without, and made a crown of gold to it round about.
